comparison_rule: Exact GLB bytes; sidecar compact UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and unchanged array order; no timestamps or request IDs.

features.reason: Exact source hashes, package versions and compiler import closure; retain the separate .ok bytes.
Existing nominal definition and stable occurrence identities, including generated keys.
Normalized SI dimensions, authored/default placements, site frames and typed resolved values.
Ownership is a semantic relation; it does not create GLB transform parenting.
Declared rigid following is metadata; its evaluated world motion is baked separately.
Endpoints, axes, initial angles and limits are metadata, not destination constraints.
This finite profile preserves explicit no_body, prescribed motion, disabled collision and gravity declarations.
Source linear RGBA and actual GLB PBR values are retained; metallic=0 and roughness=0.7 are exporter defaults.
Boxes use triangulated faces; spheres use the existing finite tessellation and binary32 vertices.
Evaluated world poses use the existing sampled GLB translation/rotation tracks; no live controller is delivered.
Source binary64 quantities and exact times are retained in metadata; GLB geometry/animation use binary32.
Action/event descriptions are retained, but GLB cannot execute OntoKin methods, actions or source edits.
No destination rigid-body simulation, collision response or live joint constraint is implemented.
The sidecar is not a substitute for original source text, reusable definitions and pinned dependencies.

scene.motion_authority: OntoKin reference evaluator; destination receives baked playback only
